text:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate on inference-runtime (us-west1). Metric: 6.8% 5xx over 2m, error pattern shows segfaults / coredumps from model-runner pods. Incident id: INC-2026-4532.

alice: ack. oncall here — @sre-oncall are you on this?

sre-oncall: I'm on it. pulling logs now. can someone freeze deploys? :no_entry_sign:

eng-ops: deploy freeze in place for inference-runtime; increasing route weight to fallback-model for affected routing group.

ben: seeing repeated OOM lines in node logs before segfaults:
```
Dec 03 11:07:12 runner[pid=1472]: gpu_memory_exhausted: tried to allocate 5.2Gi but only 1.1Gi free
Dec 03 11:07:12 kernel: watchdog: GPU reset handled by driver
Dec 03 11:07:13 runner[pid=1472]: segfault (core dumped) at libquant.so+0x2f14
```

carla: attaching short stack from latest core dump (stripped):
```
#0  0x7f8a2b1e in quant_kernel::attn_forward(...)
#1  0x7f8a3c22 in model::forward_step(...)
#2  0x55b1c0 in runner::handle_request
```

matt: good catch. this started right after the quant-kernel rollout at 10:58. eng-runtime, any rollback candidate?

eng-runtime: rolling back quant-optim patch now (v2026.11.34 -> v2026.11.32). patch introduced a new mempool path for KV cache; might be mis-sized under large batch sizes.

alice: while rollback proceeds, can we reduce cluster batch_size and disable continuous batching for model group? would reduce throughput but limit memory pressure.

eng-ops: made the change: set model-route batch_size=1, disable_continuous_batching=true for affected ASG. Routing to fallback-model increased to 40%.

sre-oncall: running `kubectl exec` to pull /var/crash cores: grabbed core-2026-12-03-11-07.tar.gz and uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-4532/ for analysis.

ben: note: some customer requests show 502 -> gateway timeout cascade when runner pod reboots. alerting support to potential customer impact.

incident-bot: UPDATE: Customer-facing impact estimate: ~12 customer apps saw increased errors (5-10% of requests) in us-west1 between 11:06-11:20. No data exfiltration. We recommend status page message.

alice: agreed, draft status message: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors for model inference in us-west1. A partial rollback and routing changes are in progress. Some requests may see increased latency or errors. We will update when mitigations complete."

eng-ops: triggered emergency routing rule: divert 60% traffic to hosted-fallback-region (us-east1) for customers without strict region pinning.

eng-runtime: rollback completed at 11:34. model-runner pods restarted and not producing new segfaults so far. memory usage trending down.

carla: confirming: no new core dumps in past 10m, kernel logs show normal discharges. leaving increased tracing on for 30m.

sre-oncall: running post-mortem checklist: collect perf traces, heap profiles, and KVS stats; will create follow-up ticket INC-2026-4532-PM for root-cause analysis. Handoff to night oncall in 30m.

matt: follow-up action items: (1) revert quant mempool change in mainline, (2) add guardrail for mempool growth in high-batch/kv workloads, (3) add preflight smoke tests for quant kernels.

alice: assigning tasks in tracker. thanks all — moving to monitoring mode. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, error rates falling to baseline (~0.8% 5xx). Continuing monitoring; next update in 30m. Handoff to @sre-oncall-night at 12:00 PST.
